methodology.hypothesis: Equal dollar shares need not give the four factor mandates similar risk contributions. Test bounded risk-weighting within the already fixed factor-core budget,not more sector gating or a fitted increase in equity risk. Keep all momentum/value/quality/low-volatility exposures;no factor is deleted.
methodology.volatility: Reuse the original bounded_factor_shares helper on each actual style fund's63-session sample daily-return standard deviation. Its15%-35%share bounds remain unchanged. Scaling factors share one fixed source core budget;no forecast return,mean optimization or new volatility cap.
methodology.downside: Use the existing risk_estimate semideviation helper separately for each style's63daily returns minus the original frozen lagged risk-free series. The square root of mean squared negative parts divides by all63sessions,not only losses. Apply the same unmodified inverse-risk bounded-share helper and15%-35%bounds. A missing/nonfinite/zero risk estimate fails,not an invented equal-weight or cash fallback.
methodology.controlled_targets: Select the completed126relativeleadership source after its exposed results. On each original122source month ends, preserve the exact sum of MTUM/VLUE/QUAL/USMV weights and every SOXX/SPY/GLD/BIL/other target. Only the four within-core shares may change;do not recalculate equity/gold risk balance,industry leadership or gold fractions. Bounds apply inside the four-style core,not to its whole equity budget or NAV. Equal budgets are not equal-risk or equal-dollar-holding counterfactuals.
methodology.execution: Pass each new desired matrix to the unmodified parent execution path using its original126candidate handle and fixed2.5ppactualclosingholding band;the handle selects the shared execution rule,not a claim to replay old inputs/positions. Each10y/5ybase/stress account independently startsUSD10000withdeployment,5/20bp,USD1/order,1/2session delayed requests. Actual positions/feedback recomputed only after publication;no overwrite,extra daily trigger or fee rebate.
methodology.source: Use the original audited12fund price/risk-free snapshot and full parent frozen source/helper graph. No new quote,current holdings,synthetic price,independent-family claim or altered source-vintage choice. Original200sector breadth/126leadership/63-126-252gold law and W42/forward rules remain.
methodology.prior_art: The prior bounded volatility and downside-risk helper implementations are reused without changing old studies. The older downside study balanced aggregate growth/gold budgets;here only its scalar risk estimator is adapted to individual style funds. Sample-volatility uses original raw fund returns while semideviation uses excess returns,according to their prior laws;this is not isolated causal tail-vs-total-risk attribution.
methodology.selection: Exactly two fixed constructions after144exposed-history configurations. Net excessSharpe>1,CAGR>same-costSPY,stressCAGR>basecostSPY andDD<=15%must hold jointly across all paths. Historical qualification still requires independent actual future evidence.
